exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table below about camping tips and tick the appropriate column. Then make sentences using always or never.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi kemping maslahatlari jadvaliga qarang va tegishli ustunga ✓ qo'ying. So'ngra always yoki never bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:  DO  /  DON'T

Birinchi qatorga kitob ✓ ni ALLAQAChON
'DON'T' ustuniga qo'ygan (namuna).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (✓ qayerga):

  1  leave the camp fire burning when you go
     to sleep                        →  DON'T
  2  have a torch with you           →  DO
  3  take too many clothes with you  →  DON'T
  4  put your tent up next to a river →  DON'T
  5  keep a lot of money in your tent →  DON'T
  6  leave rubbish behind            →  DON'T
  7  tell your family where you are  →  DO

  Ya'ni: DO — 2 va 7 (2 ta)
         DON'T — 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 (5 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  NEVER leave the camp fire burning when you
    go to sleep.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ALWAYS have a torch with you.

 3  NEVER take too many clothes with you.

 4  NEVER put your tent up next to a river.

 5  NEVER keep a lot of money in your tent.

 6  NEVER leave rubbish behind.

 7  ALWAYS tell your family where you are.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Uxlagani ketayotganda gulxanni yonib
    turgan holda hech qachon qoldirmang.
 2  Doim qo'l fonarini yoningizda olib yuring.
 3  Hech qachon juda ko'p kiyim olmang.
 4  Chodiringizni hech qachon daryo yoniga
    tikmang.
 5  Chodiringizda hech qachon ko'p pul
    saqlamang.
 6  Hech qachon axlat tashlab ketmang.
 7  Doim oilangizga qayerdaligingizni ayting.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  DON'T — yonayotgan gulxan O'RMON
    YONG'INIGA sabab bo'ladi.
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never light fires in
     forests. Trees will burn.')

 2  DO — fonar kechasi ZARUR (kempingda
    elektr yo'q).

 3  DON'T — ko'p kiyim = OG'IR yuk;
    hammasini o'zingiz ko'tarasiz.

 4  DON'T — daryo TOSHIB ketishi mumkin,
    chodir suv ostida qoladi.

 5  DON'T — chodirni QULFLAB bo'lmaydi,
    pul o'g'irlanadi.

 6  DON'T — axlat tabiatni IFLOSLANTIRADI.
    (Coursebook 99 va 103-betlar)

 7  DO — biror narsa bo'lsa, oilangiz
    sizni QAYERDAN qidirishni biladi.


OLTIN QOIDA:
  DO ustuni    →  ALWAYS + fe'l
  DON'T ustuni →  NEVER + fe'l

  Ikkalasi ham BUYRUQ maylida — ega YO'Q.


DIQQAT — 'PUT YOUR TENT UP':
  'to put up a tent' = chodir tikmoq
  AJRALADIGAN fe'l:
     put your tent up  ✓
     put up your tent  ✓
     put IT up         ✓
     put up IT         ✗


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... BURNING':
  'leave the camp fire BURNING'
  = gulxanni YONIB TURGAN holda qoldirmoq

  'leave + ot + -ING' — holatni bildiradi:
     leave the tap running
     leave the door open


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE RUBBISH BEHIND':
  'to leave BEHIND' = ortda qoldirib ketmoq
  'behind' gap oxirida turadi.


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY':
  'take TOO MANY clothes' = haddan tashqari
  ko'p kiyim
  'too many' + SANALADIGAN
  'too much' + SANALMAYDIGAN

  DIQQAT: 'clothes' — DOIM ko'plikda
  ('a clothe' XATO; birligi 'a piece of
   clothing').


DIQQAT — 'TELL YOUR FAMILY WHERE YOU ARE':
  'tell somebody WHERE you are'
  Ergash gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI
  (savol tartibi EMAS):
     'where YOU ARE'    ✓
     'where ARE YOU'    ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  camping        = kemping, chodirda dam olish
  a camp fire    = gulxan
  to burn        = yonmoq
  a torch        = qo'l fonari (britancha;
                   AmE: a flashlight)
  clothes        = kiyim-kechak (DOIM ko'plik)
  a tent         = chodir
  to put up a tent = chodir tikmoq
  next to        = yonida
  to leave behind = ortda qoldirmoq

points.en: 1  leave the camp fire burning when you go to sleep — DON'T  →  Never leave the camp fire burning when you go to sleep.
points.uz: Uxlagani ketayotganda gulxanni yonib turgan holda hech qachon qoldirmang.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (✓ 'Don't' ustunida).
Sababi: o'rmon yong'ini.
'leave + ot + -ING' — holat qurilmasi.

points.en: 2  have a torch with you — DO  →  Always have a torch with you.
points.uz: Doim qo'l fonarini yoningizda olib yuring.
points.noteUz:
DO → ALWAYS.
Kempingda elektr yo'q, kechasi fonar ZARUR.
'a torch' — britancha (AmE: a flashlight).

points.en: 3  take too many clothes with you — DON'T  →  Never take too many clothes with you.
points.uz: Hech qachon juda ko'p kiyim olmang.
points.noteUz:
DON'T → NEVER.
Ko'p kiyim = og'ir yuk.
'TOO MANY' + sanaladigan.
'clothes' — DOIM ko'plikda.

points.en: 4  put your tent up next to a river — DON'T  →  Never put your tent up next to a river.
points.uz: Chodiringizni hech qachon daryo yoniga tikmang.
points.noteUz:
DON'T → NEVER.
Daryo toshib ketishi mumkin.
'put up a tent' — AJRALADIGAN fe'l
('put IT up' ✓ / 'put up IT' ✗).

points.en: 5  keep a lot of money in your tent — DON'T  →  Never keep a lot of money in your tent.
points.uz: Chodiringizda hech qachon ko'p pul saqlamang.

points.en: 6  leave rubbish behind — DON'T  →  Never leave rubbish behind.
points.noteUz:
DON'T → NEVER.
'to leave BEHIND' = ortda qoldirib ketmoq.
Coursebook 99 va 103-betlarning ekologik
mavzusi bilan bog'liq.

points.en: 7  tell your family where you are — DO  →  Always tell your family where you are.
points.noteUz:
DO → ALWAYS.
Xavfsizlik uchun zarur.

DIQQAT — SO'Z TARTIBI:
'where YOU ARE' ✓ (ergash gap tartibi)
'where ARE YOU' ✗ (savol tartibi)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the phrases below.
exercises.explanationUz:
IBORALAR (4 ta):
  you should
  I think it's a good idea
  Why don't you
  I don't think it's a good idea

MATN: Erik Semga xat yozgan (do'kon ochish
haqida).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  2  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  3  YOU SHOULD
  4  WHY DON'T YOU


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Sam,

  I'm pleased to hear that you want to open
  your own shop. I'm worried though, that you
  want to ask your friend for the money you
  need.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to open a place of
  your own but I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  to borrow money from your friend because he
  may want to get involved in the shop and that
  can become a problem. Perhaps YOU SHOULD wait
  a little while so that you can make some
  money of your own. WHY DON'T YOU ask the bank
  for a loan?

  Hope to hear from you soon.

                              Love,
                              Eric


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Sem,

  O'z do'koningni ochmoqchi ekaningni eshitib
  xursandman. Lekin kerakli pulni do'stingdan
  so'ramoqchi ekaningdan xavotirdaman.

  Menimcha, o'z joyingni ochish yaxshi fikr,
  lekin do'stingdan qarz olish yaxshi fikr
  emas, chunki u do'konga aralashishni xohlab
  qolishi mumkin va bu muammoga aylanadi.
  Balki biroz kutib, o'zing pul topishing
  kerakdir. Bankdan qarz so'rasang-chi?

  Tez orada javobingni kutaman.

  Mehr bilan, Erik


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — FAQAT GRAMMATIKA:

  1  '... TO OPEN a place of your own'
     Keyin 'TO + fe'l' → 'a good idea TO ...'
     Ma'no IJOBIY ('I'm PLEASED to hear')
     → I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  2  'BUT ... TO BORROW money'
     Yana 'TO + fe'l', lekin oldida 'BUT'
     va sabab salbiy ('can become a PROBLEM')
     → I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  3  'Perhaps ... WAIT a little while'
     Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l ('wait')
     → YOU SHOULD

  4  '... ASK the bank for a loan?'
     Gap SAVOL BELGISI bilan tugaydi!
     → WHY DON'T YOU


UCh BELGI (Grammar 62-bet, 6-mashq bilan
AYNAN bir xil):

  A) 'TO + fe'l' keladi  →  it's a good idea TO
  B) 'to' SIZ fe'l       →  you should
  C) SAVOL BELGISI (?)   →  Why don't you


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda: Tresi → Lindaga (Rimga ko'chish)
  Bu yerda: Erik → Semga (do'kon ochish)

  Tuzilishi AYNAN bir xil:
     1) ijobiy fikr
     2) 'but' + salbiy fikr
     3) 'Perhaps/Maybe' + you should
     4) 'Why don't you ...?'

  Kitob ataylab takrorlagan — qolipni
  mustahkamlash uchun.


DIQQAT — 'OF YOUR OWN':
  'a place OF YOUR OWN' = o'zingizniki
  'your OWN shop' = o'z do'koningiz

  'own' egalikni KUCHAYTIRADI:
     'my own house' = aynan mening uyim


DIQQAT — 'SO THAT':
  'wait a little while SO THAT you can make
   some money'
  'so that' = ... uchun (MAQSAD)

  Grammar 62-bet, 9-mashqning 2-bandi ham
  shu haqda edi:
  'Tonia is saving money SO she can go on
   holiday.'


DIQQAT — 'GET INVOLVED IN':
  'to get INVOLVED IN something' = biror
  ishga aralashmoq


DIQQAT — 'ASK FOR':
  'ask your friend FOR the money'
  'ask the bank FOR a loan'
  'to ask somebody FOR something' = so'ramoq

  DIQQAT: 'ask somebody something' — savol
  berish ('ask me a question');
  'ask somebody FOR something' — narsa
  so'rash.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  pleased        = mamnun, xursand
  your own       = o'zingizniki
  to borrow      = qarz olmoq
  to lend        = qarz bermoq (TESKARISI)
  to get involved in = aralashmoq
  perhaps        = balki
  so that        = ... uchun
  a loan         = qarz, kredit
  to make money  = pul topmoq
wordList: I think it's a good idea
I don't think it's a good idea

items.answer: I think it's a good idea
items.uz: Menimcha, o'z joyingni ochish yaxshi fikr

commonMistake.whyUz:
GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'TO OPEN' — 'TO + fe'l'.
Buni faqat 'it's a good idea TO ...' talab
qiladi.

MA'NO KALITI: Erik do'kon ochishni QO'LLAB-
QUVVATLAYDI ('I'm PLEASED to hear that you
want to open your own shop') → IJOBIY.

'a place OF YOUR OWN' = o'zingizniki.

items.sentence: 2  but ....................................... to borrow money from your friend
items.answer: I don't think it's a good idea
items.uz: lekin do'stingdan qarz olish yaxshi fikr emas

commonMistake.whyUz:
GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'TO BORROW' —
yana 'TO + fe'l'.

IKKI MA'NO KALITI:
  1) 'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik
  2) sabab salbiy: 'that can become a PROBLEM'

→ SALBIY shakl.

DIQQAT: inkor BOSH gapga qo'yiladi
('I DON'T think').

'to BORROW' = qarz OLMOQ;
'to LEND' = qarz BERMOQ (teskarisi).

GRAMMATIK KALIT: keyin 'WAIT' — 'TO' SIZ
asosiy fe'l!

Buni faqat 'you SHOULD + fe'l' talab qiladi:
  'you should WAIT'          ✓
  'it's a good idea WAIT'    ✗
   (bu yerda 'TO wait' kerak bo'lardi)

'perhaps' = balki (maslahatni yumshatadi).
'a little while' = biroz vaqt.

ENG ANIQ KALIT: gap SAVOL BELGISI (?) bilan
tugaydi!

Ro'yxatdagi yagona savol shakli:
'Why don't you ...?'

Yana: keyin 'ASK' — 'to' siz asosiy fe'l.

'to ask somebody FOR something' = so'ramoq.
'a loan' = qarz, kredit.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notice of library rules and make sentences about what you must and mustn't do, as in the example. — BEARBROOK LIBRARY RULES
exercises.instructionUz: Kutubxona qoidalari e'lonini o'qing va nima qilish va qilmaslik kerakligi haqida namunadagidek gap tuzing. — BEARBROOK KUTUBXONASI QOIDALARI
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LON MATNI:

  BEARBROOK LIBRARY RULES
  Remember!
   1  Be quiet
   2  No smoking
   3  Return books on time
   4  No eating or drinking
   5  Don't bring pets into the library
   6  Keep books in good condition


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  You MUST be quiet.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  You MUSTN'T smoke.

 3  You MUST return books on time.

 4  You MUSTN'T eat or drink.

 5  You MUSTN'T bring pets into the library.

 6  You MUST keep books in good condition.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Jim bo'lishingiz kerak.
 2  Chekmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Kitoblarni o'z vaqtida qaytarishingiz kerak.
 4  Ovqat yeyish yoki ichish mumkin emas.
 5  Kutubxonaga uy hayvonlarini olib
    kirmasligingiz kerak.
 6  Kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlashingiz
    kerak.


OLTIN QOIDA — E'LON ShAKLI JAVOBNI BERADI:

  IJOBIY buyruq  →  MUST
     'BE quiet'                (1)
     'RETURN books on time'    (3)
     'KEEP books in good condition' (6)

  'NO + -ING'    →  MUSTN'T
     'NO SMOKING'              (2)
     'NO EATING OR DRINKING'   (4)

  'DON'T + fe'l' →  MUSTN'T
     'DON'T BRING pets'        (5)

  Ya'ni: 3 ta MUST, 3 ta MUSTN'T.


'NO + -ING' NI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  E'LONDA          →  GAPDA
  'No smoking'     →  'You mustn't SMOKE.'
  'No eating'      →  'You mustn't EAT.'
  'No parking'     →  'You mustn't PARK.'

  DIQQAT: '-ING' TUShIB QOLADI!
     'You mustn't smokING' ✗
     'You mustn't SMOKE'   ✓

  Chunki 'mustn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl
  keladi.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'No eating OR drinking'
  → 'You mustn't eat OR drink.'

  INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR':
     'You mustn't eat OR drink.'  ✓
     'You mustn't eat AND drink.' — ma'no
       o'zgaradi (ikkalasini BIRGA qilmaslik)


DIQQAT — 'BRING INTO':
  'bring pets INTO the library'
  'into' — ichkariga HARAKAT.

  Coursebook 102-bet, 13a, 8-o'quvchi:
  'You mustn't bring pets INTO school.'


DIQQAT — 'IN GOOD CONDITION':
  'keep books IN GOOD CONDITION'
  = kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlamoq

  'condition' = holat, ahvol.
  'in good/bad condition' — turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' YANA:
  'return books ON time' = kitoblarni o'z
  vaqtida qaytarmoq

  Workbook 57-bet, 6-mashqning 6-bandi ham
  shu edi: 'pay the rent ON time'.


NEGA 'MUSTN'T', 'SHOULDN'T' EMAS:
  Bular KUTUBXONANING RASMIY QOIDALARI —
  maslahat emas, MAJBURIYAT va TAQIQ.

  Grammar 60-bet: 'We use must b) FOR RULES'.


RASM:
  Kutubxonachi ayol stolda kitob ustida
  o'tiribdi, orqasida kitob javonlari.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a library      = kutubxona
  a notice       = e'lon
  quiet          = jim
  to return      = qaytarmoq
  on time        = o'z vaqtida
  to bring into  = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  condition      = holat, ahvol
  in good condition = yaxshi holatda

points.en: 1  Be quiet  →  You must be quiet.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
IJOBIY buyruq → MUST.
'quiet' = jim ('quite' bilan ADASHTIRMANG).

'NO + -ING' → MUSTN'T.

DIQQAT: '-ING' TUSHIB QOLADI!
'You mustn't smokING' ✗
'You mustn't SMOKE'   ✓
(mustn't dan keyin ASOSIY shakl).

points.en: 3  Return books on time  →  You must return books on time.
points.noteUz:
IJOBIY buyruq → MUST.
'ON time' = o'z vaqtida (turg'un ibora).
Workbook 57-bet: 'pay the rent ON time'.

points.en: 4  No eating or drinking  →  You mustn't eat or drink.
points.uz: Ovqat yeyish yoki ichish mumkin emas.
points.noteUz:
'NO + -ING' → MUSTN'T, '-ING' tushadi.

DIQQAT — 'OR':
INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi:
'You mustn't eat OR drink.' ✓

points.en: 5  Don't bring pets into the library  →  You mustn't bring pets into the library.
points.uz: Kutubxonaga uy hayvonlarini olib kirmasligingiz kerak.
points.noteUz:
'DON'T + fe'l' → MUSTN'T + fe'l.

'bring INTO' — ichkariga harakat.
Coursebook 102-bet, 13a: 'You mustn't bring
pets into school.'

points.en: 6  Keep books in good condition  →  You must keep books in good condition.
points.noteUz:
IJOBIY buyruq → MUST.
'IN GOOD CONDITION' = yaxshi holatda
(turg'un ibora).
'keep + ot + holat' — CB 101-betdagi
'keep the room clean' bilan bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue below and fill in the gaps with the appropriate modal verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni mos modal fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni MUZEYGA olib
bormoqda va qoidalarni tushuntiryapti.

(Grammar 62-betdagi HAYVONOT BOG'I dialogi
bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish!)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUST
  2  CAN
  3  CAN'T
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  CAN
  6  CAN'T
  7  MUSTN'T
  8  CAN
  9  CAN


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher: Today we are going to visit the
           museum children and there are some
           things we need to talk about.
           First you MUST always stay close
           to me.

  S1:      CAN we bring our cameras?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
           pictures.

  S2:      CAN we bring our lunch with us?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T eat in
           the museum.

  S3:      Where CAN we eat?

  Teacher: You CAN eat in the restaurant which
           is next to the museum.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  O'qituvchi: Bugun muzeyga boramiz, bolalar,
              va gaplashishimiz kerak bo'lgan
              bir necha narsa bor. Birinchidan,
              doim menga yaqin turishingiz
              KERAK.
  1-o'quvchi: Fotoapparatlarimizni olib
              kelsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Suratga
              olMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  2-o'quvchi: Tushligimizni olib kelsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Muzeyda ovqat
              yeMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  3-o'quvchi: Qayerda ovqat yeya olamiz?
  O'qituvchi: Muzey yonidagi restoranda ovqat
              yeyishingiz MUMKIN.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'First you ... always STAY CLOSE to me.'
    Bu — QAT'IY qoida → MUST.
    (Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogining
     oxirgi gapi ham shu edi:
     'Everyone MUST stay close to me.')

 2  '... we BRING our cameras?'
    O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN.

 3  'No, you ...!'
    QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
    'CAN we?' → 'you CAN'T'.

 4  'You ... TAKE ANY PICTURES.'
    Bu — muzeyning TAQIQI → MUSTN'T.
    (Workbook 57-bet, F belgisi:
     'Don't take pictures.')

 5  '... we BRING our lunch?'
    Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.

 6  'No, you ...!'
    Yana qisqa javob → CAN'T.

 7  'You ... EAT IN THE MUSEUM.'
    Muzeyda ovqat yeyish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

 8  'WHERE ... we eat?'
    'Where' bilan savol — IMKONIYAT so'ralyapti
    → CAN.

 9  'You ... EAT IN THE RESTAURANT.'
    O'qituvchi RUXSAT beryapti → CAN.


NAQSh — DIALOGNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN'
                        (2, 5, 8)
  O'QITUVChI:
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (3, 6)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (4, 7)
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (9)


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T' YONMA-YON:
  'No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
   pictures.'

  Nega ikkalasi?
     'CAN'T'   — SAVOLGA javob (qisqa javob
                 savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi)
     'MUSTN'T' — TAQIQNI kuchaytirish
                 (muzey qoidasi)

  Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialogda ham
  shunday edi:
  'No, you can't. You mustn't park here —
   it's illegal.'


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKORDA:
  'You mustn't take ANY pictures.'
  = hech qanday surat olmang

  INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY':
     'I don't have ANY money.'  ✓
     'I don't have SOME money.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHICH IS NEXT TO':
  'the restaurant WHICH IS NEXT TO the museum'
  = muzey YONIDAGI restoran

  'which' — narsalar uchun ergash gap
  bog'lovchisi ('who' — odamlar uchun).
  'next to' = yonida.


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:

  HAYVONOT BOG'I (Grammar 62)  MUZEY (WB 58)
  ──────────────────────────   ─────────────
  must follow rules            must stay close
  mustn't feed the animals     mustn't take
                               pictures
  Can we touch? — No, you      Can we bring
  can't                        cameras? — No,
                               you can't
  Can we take pictures? —      Can we bring
  Yes, you can                 lunch? — No
  must stay close to me        can eat in the
                               restaurant

  Ikkala dialog ham bir xil qolipda tuzilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a museum      = muzey
  a camera      = fotoapparat
  lunch         = tushlik
  a restaurant  = restoran
  next to       = yonida
  which         = qaysiki (narsalar uchun)

items.sentence: 1  Teacher: First you ........................... always stay close to me.
items.uz: Birinchidan, doim menga yaqin turishingiz kerak.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Bu — o'qituvchining QAT'IY qoidasi → MUST.

Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogi ham
shu gap bilan tugagan:
'Everyone MUST stay close to me.'

DIQQAT: 'MUST ALWAYS stay' — ravish modal
bilan asosiy fe'l ORASIDA.

O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN ...?

'Must we bring our cameras?' =
'olib kelishimiz SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz.

Dialogda o'quvchilar UCH marta savol beradi
(2, 5, 8) va uchalasi ham 'CAN'.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN we bring?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'

'No, you mustn't' — grammatik jihatdan
mumkin, lekin qisqa javob qoidasiga ko'ra
'can't' to'g'ri.

Bu — MUZEYNING TAQIQI → MUSTN'T.

Oldingi 'can't' savolga javob edi; bu esa
TAQIQNI kuchaytiradi.
(CB 102-bet, 16e: 'No, you can't. You MUSTN'T
park here.' — bir xil naqsh.)

Workbook 57-bet, F belgisi:
'Don't take pictures.'

'ANY' — inkor gapda ('some' emas).

items.sentence: 5  S2: ................... we bring our lunch with us?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.
2-band bilan bir xil.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
'CAN we bring?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'
3-band bilan bir xil.

Muzeyda ovqat yeyish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T
(eksponatlarga zarar yetishi mumkin).

4-band bilan bir xil naqsh:
'No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T ...'

'WHERE' bilan savol — IMKONIYAT so'ralyapti
→ CAN.

'Where MUST we eat?' = 'qayerda yeyishimiz
SHART?' — g'alati.

Savol so'zi + modal + ega + fe'l:
'Where CAN we eat?'

items.sentence: 9  Teacher: You ........................ eat in the restaurant which is next to the museum.
items.uz: Muzey yonidagi restoranda ovqat yeyishingiz mumkin.

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'qituvchi RUXSAT beryapti → CAN.

Savol 'Where CAN we eat?' edi, javob ham
'CAN' bilan.

'WHICH IS NEXT TO the museum' — ergash gap
('which' narsalar uchun; 'next to' = yonida).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  CAN
  3  SHOULD
  4  CAN'T
  5  MUSTN'T


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'You SHOULD always wear a seatbelt.'
    Xavfsizlik kamari — IJOBIY, foydali
    maslahat.
    'shouldn't wear a seatbelt' = xavfli
    maslahat bo'lardi.
    → SHOULD

 2  'CAN I have a glass of water, please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    'Should I have ...?' = 'ichishim kerakmi?'
    — boshqa ma'no.
    → CAN
    (Grammar 61 va 63-betlarda ham shu gap
     bor edi — kitob uch marta takrorlagan!)

 3  'Harvey SHOULD take singing lessons because
     he has a fantastic voice.'
    KALIT: 'because he has a FANTASTIC VOICE'
    — sabab IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy.
    'can't take lessons' bo'lsa sabab bilan
    mos kelmaydi.
    → SHOULD

 4  'You CAN'T go to the cinema tonight, because
     you have to do your homework.'
    KALIT: 'because you HAVE TO DO your
    homework' — uy vazifasi bor, demak
    kinoga BORA OLMAYDI.
    → CAN'T

 5  'You MUSTN'T play music after eleven
     o'clock at night.'
    Kechasi soat 11 dan keyin musiqa qo'yish —
    qo'shnilarga xalaqit, ko'p joyda
    QONUNAN taqiqlangan.
    'should play music after eleven' = teskari
    maslahat.
    → MUSTN'T


ENG MUHIM KALIT — SABAB GAPI:

  3 va 4-bandlarda javob 'BECAUSE' dan
  keyingi qismda:
     3  'because he has a FANTASTIC voice'
        → ijobiy → SHOULD
     4  'because you HAVE TO do your homework'
        → to'sqinlik → CAN'T


MODALLAR FARQI — QISQA ESLATMA:
  SHOULD   — maslahat (yumshoq)   (1, 3)
  CAN      — ruxsat so'rash        (2)
  CAN'T    — imkoni yo'q / ruxsat yo'q (4)
  MUSTN'T  — qat'iy taqiq          (5)


DIQQAT — 1-BANDDAGI 'ALWAYS':
  'You should ALWAYS wear a seatbelt.'
  Ravish MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L ORASIDA:
     should ALWAYS wear  ✓
     ALWAYS should wear  ✗


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'HAVE TO':
  'you HAVE TO do your homework'
  'have to' = shart (must bilan bir xil ma'no)

  Bu gapda IKKI modal bor:
     'can't go' — imkoni yo'q
     'have to do' — majburiyat


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'AFTER ELEVEN O'CLOCK':
  'after eleven o'clock AT NIGHT'
  = kechasi soat 11 dan keyin

  'at night' = kechasi (predlog 'at').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a seatbelt      = xavfsizlik kamari
  singing lessons = qo'shiq darslari
  fantastic       = ajoyib
  a voice         = ovoz
  to have to      = shart bo'lmoq
  at night        = kechasi

items.textEn: 1  You shouldn't/should always wear a seatbelt.
items.whyUz:
Xavfsizlik kamari — hayot saqlaydi, IJOBIY
maslahat → SHOULD.

'shouldn't wear a seatbelt' = xavfli maslahat
bo'lardi.

DIQQAT — 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
'should ALWAYS wear' ✓
(ravish modal bilan asosiy fe'l ORASIDA).

items.textEn: 2  Should/Can I have a glass of water, please?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, ruxsat so'rash
→ CAN.

'Should I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim KERAKMI?' — maslahat so'rash,
boshqa ma'no.

DIQQAT: bu gap Grammar 61 va 63-betlarda ham
bor edi — kitob UCH marta takrorlagan.

items.textEn: 3  Harvey can't/should take singing lessons because he has a fantastic voice.
items.uz: Xarvi qo'shiq darslariga borishi kerak, chunki uning ovozi ajoyib.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — SABAB GAPI:
'because he has a FANTASTIC VOICE'
Sabab IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy
→ SHOULD.

'can't take lessons' bo'lsa sabab bilan mos
kelmaydi (ajoyib ovoz — dars olishga TO'SIQ
emas, aksincha SABAB).

DIQQAT: ega 'HARVEY' (III shaxs birlik)
bo'lsa ham 'should' o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 4  You can/can't go to the cinema tonight, because you have to do your homework.
items.uz: Bugun kechqurun kinoga bora olmaysiz, chunki uy vazifangizni bajarishingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
KALIT — SABAB GAPI:
'because you HAVE TO DO your homework'
Uy vazifasi TO'SQINLIK qilyapti → CAN'T.

'can go' bo'lsa sabab bilan ZID bo'lardi.

Grammar 62-bet, 7-mashqning 4-bandi ham
aynan shunday edi:
'I CAN'T go to the cinema. I must study for
a test.'

'have to' = shart (must bilan bir xil).

items.textEn: 5  You mustn't/should play music after eleven o'clock at night.
items.uz: Kechasi soat 11 dan keyin musiqa qo'ymasligingiz kerak.
items.whyUz:
Kechasi baland musiqa — qo'shnilarga xalaqit;
ko'p joyda QONUNAN taqiqlangan → MUSTN'T.

'should play music after eleven' = 'kechasi
musiqa qo'yishingiz kerak' — teskari maslahat.

Coursebook 101-bet, 11-mashq jadvali:
'play loud music' → CAN'T.

'AT night' = kechasi (predlog 'at').
